DefaultDialogue: Careful! No stepping on my honeysuckle! Hard enough to grow anything in this bleeding place without bootprints through my flower bed.
This is who we really are, stranger. Cowards, the lot of us. Willing to plow under friends and neighbors just to save our own hide.
Tread careful, stranger. The longer you stay in this place, the more like you are to lose yourself.
Best keep on the march, stranger. See in this place, sometimes your final rest ain’t your final rest.
You don’t know what it was like, stranger. Friends and loved ones going about their day, minding their own, off they go into town, and they come back Lost!
Gone you say? Well that don’t change a thing!
I hear the Vigil’s shuffled off the old mortal coil? Well, curse or no curse, the dead here are still restless.
Eggs, almonds, vanilla, a touch of rosewater, and… magic!
These are dark days, friend. But in here, things are always sweet! Enjoy a sample of the butchtel.
Ah, my friend! At last, we are free! There is hope again in the eyes of the people.
Where am I from? There is a land to the Northwest of here, stranger. My Empress is most concerned about the happenings here.
Take care who you choose to serve, stranger.
Tread carefully, friend. The Lost are not easily laid to rest, and those with a sense of grievance or sanctimony usually do not go quietly.
Fate, it seems, is not done with you. It pleases me that you are well.
Strange. So strange! Bark, roots, leaves, branches—the power of Azoth permeates them all.
Out of balance? Nonsense! This land is positively teeming with all the energies of the universe! Life itself runs through the very soil.
You’ve seen it? Touched it? And come back to tell the tale?
The balance has been restored! Yes… I feel it now.
Don’t make any trouble, outsider. Just because times are hard doesn’t mean you can simply do as you please.
There are no heroes out there, walking the road, waiting to come save us.
Do you know what it takes to protect a home in times like these, stranger? To make hard choices to keep the ones you love safe?
It was true what I said about hard times, stranger. But I always had doubts.
Maybe now that the Vigil’s reign of terror is over, we can begin to trust each other once more.
What’s it like out there, friend? Living by your wits, fighting the good fight. I’d be like to follow you if it weren’t for I’m needed here.
So chivalry’s dead, is it? I suppose nothing endures in this strange new world of ours.
The Bright Vigil has fallen? Good riddance. Maybe someone like you can be a new beacon for Brightwood in the darkness.
I thought the Bright Vigil was standing tall to protect us from the dark forces, but it was we who needed protecting from them!
Well then, welcome to Brightwood, I suppose. Mind your soul around these parts - they tend to get Lost.
Don't know what you've heard about Brightwood, stranger, but it may well be true.
As difficult as it may be to accept the truths you exposed, I think we made a difference in the fight against the Lost here.
I heard you eventually made your way out to the Fen!
I see you, stranger, and I see your soul.
Brightwood is no different than anywhere else on Aeternum.
What you have brought me is powerful, but it is not enough. We need something to refine the moss spores.
I will remain, to observe the Angry Earth and Lost.
It seems unfair that we spend decades here battling the Lost, only to now face a new threat.
You've done Brightwood a kindness, traveler. We've finally gotten a chance to catch our collective breath…before the next threat looms.
Move along you.
Duty calls me to Brightwood, where strength is truly tested. I am at home here. We shall see if you have equal mettle. [ Level 24 required for Brightwood faction missions ]
Duty calls me to Brightwood, where strength is truly tested. I am at home here. We shall see if you have equal mettle.
Those books can't prepare you for Brightwood. No matter, as I'll enjoy picking over your corpse in due time.
You light bringers bore me. If your belief really worked, then why does the darkness remain here? Save your breath. I already know.
What mysteries lie in wait for us to uncover? What secrets of this island lurk phantasmal at the edges of our understanding?
The quest to know and understand is our shared duty. Return when you understand more. [ Level 24 required for Brightwood faction missions ]
The quest to know and understand is our shared duty. How may I service you, fellow erudite?
Oh this will be fascinating! A Marauder brute here in Brightwood. I look forward to learning from your failures.
Yes, come hither my senseless friend. Tell me again how belief in fairy tales helps to solve mankind's ills. I never tire of it.
My child, having not chosen a path is still a choice. It's never too late to leave darkness for the light.
Ah, a fellow seeker of justice. It will be my sacred honor to assist you. [ Level 24 required for Brightwood faction missions ]
Ah, a fellow seeker of justice. It will be my sacred honor to assist you.
Well aren't you a strong-looking one! Not that it'll do you much good here in Brightwood. But then, choices do have consequences, and I'm afraid you chose unwisely, Marauder.
Oh my dear, so much rushing about, trying to learn everything. Such a pointless waste, when all we need is belief in a just cause.
Hi there!
I trust you've heard at least some of the history of Brightwood?
You know, I've come to the conclusion that you and I - we have a lot in common.
Welcome, welcome! Thank you again for finding that Locus.
Oh dear, you startled me! The spooks and spirits of this town have got me on edge.
Hello, I'm Master Fisher Park! Fishing and Alchemy are my trades.
Salutations. I'm Master Fisher Park! Fishing and Alchemy are my trades.
My research is going along well, thanks to you.
<g id="grace_crossarms" />When I heard the rumors from Everfall, I knew it wouldn't be long.<g id="grace_lean" /> The Corrupted have come to Brightwood in full force.
<g id="grace_consider" />I had thought to seek support from rangers in other territories,<g id="grace_convince" /> but I think you and I can handle this.
<g id="grace_embarrassed" />I can't dwell on past failures. The present peril is too great. The Corrupted still have a major presence<g id="grace_gesturebothhands" /> at Reida's Burrow.
<g id="grace_worry" />I will remain and keep an eye on the Corrupted operations here.
They<g id="male_compliment" /> really should advertise the beauty of Greyvale.<g id="male_clasphandsgrateful" /> There is something marvelous about the ancient trees and the sparkling water.
<g id="male_gesturehereweare" />Have you seen, really seen the landscape of Greyvale?<g id="male_gestureup" /> The light falling through the leaves, or dancing across the lakes.

<g id="male_converseright" />There’s something to be said<g id="male_converseleft" /> about the energy in moving water, the way it draws<g id="male_spreadarms001" /> your eye and catches it. The power<g id="male_nod1" /> that just leaps off the canvas and fills a room.
<g id="male_think" />Waterfalls are thrilling indeed,<g id="male_lookdownohmy" /> but I also like to paint more tranquil landscapes.
<g id="male_nodproud" />Thanks to your help, my name<g id="male_fistraiseleft" /> shall be known in every household in Aeternum.
Trees<g id="grace_consider" /> live for so long, and experience so much. I wish I could know what they know.
<g id="grace_consider" />Do you sense it, traveler? The force of life rides on the breeze from the south -<g id="grace_bowhead" /> the only vibrant flora remaining in these dead lands.
<g id="grace_lean" />Now it is time for you to repay my generosity. The secrets of the Angry Earth are<g id="grace_headshakeno" /> not lightly shared, and I have need of your strength.
<g id="grace_dismiss" />Begone, human. As<g id="grace_fistchest" /> I resume my place among the Angry Earth, I <g id="grace_headshakeno" />cannot guarantee your safety.
<g id="male_darnit" />If you're headed into Greyvale, I'd offer you one piece of advice.<g id="male_scoldfingerwag" /> Don't feed the bears! Especially not with your own flesh and blood.
<g id="male_spreadarmscalm" />Say there, are you headed across the river, into Greyvale?
<g id="male_darnit" />If I'm being completely honest, though, I really<g id="male_throwarms" /> don't know what I'm supposed to do.
<g id="male_hanghead" />Still working up the nerve. This is<g id="male_shrugbrief" /> harder than I thought.

<g id="litearmor_dismissgetlost2" />If you're looking for the Brightwood settlement, it's to the north.<g id="litearmor_handsonhipsshakeheads" /> Nothing to the south, except for lost love... and remorse.
<g id="litearmor_agree1" />It may seem hard to believe, but this<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" /> was once one of the safest and liveliest parts of Brightwood.
<g id="litearmor_hopeless" />Reading this is like visiting an old friend -<g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" /> it's very… emotional.
<g id="litearmor_handsonhipsshakeheads" />It just goes to show, life is only<g id="litearmor_tiltheadremember" /> for those bold and courageous enough to truly live it.
<g id="female_crossarms" />The villages don't look at all inviting,<g id="female_shrugnothingicando" /> and the villagers even less.
<g id="female_nodrelieved" />Hello? Oh, thank goodness, you're not one of the wandering Lost.<g id="female_leanforwardsmall" /> I'm Aethelwynn, and you're the friendliest face I've seen all day.
<g id="female_worry" />You made that look easy.<g id="female_leanforwardsmall" /> Have you been treasure-hunting before?
<g id="female_worry" />You made that look easy.<g id="female_leanforwardsmall" /> Have you been treasure-hunting before?
<g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />People still live here?<g id="female_worry" /> I thought this place would be full of nothing but ghosts.

<g id="female_shrugshort" />You... still want to help me, right?<g id="female_leanpointconvince" /> Find treasure, I mean. If you don't, I'd understand.<g id="female_nodshrugokay" /> I could figure something out on my own.

<g id="female_youknow" />…Hi. Seems like you've met Baldr.

<g id="female_explains" />I owe you an explanation.<g id="female_sympathyhandsheart" /> And an awful lot of gratitude. I'm sure<g id="female_taptemple" /> you've realized the truth by now, but I'm no treasure hunter.<g id="female_shrugdontcare" /> Sorry…

<g id="female_explains" />I owe you an explanation.<g id="female_sympathyhandsheart" /> And an awful lot of gratitude. I'm sure<g id="female_taptemple" /> you've realized the truth by now, but I'm no treasure hunter.<g id="female_shrugdontcare" /> Sorry…
<g id="female_apologetic" />There is one last thing. My<g id="female_sympathyhandsheart" /> sister Emmeline's necklace. It was the<g id="female_spreadarms" /> only real valuable we owned.
<g id="female_thinking" />Can I tell you a secret? I thought you were a bit scary when we first met.

Welcome to Calvary! Meeting strangers is the only advantage of this job. Told my daughter not to join her dad’s line of work, but she never listens to me.
New to Brightwood? Well, you can get lost in a graveyard and fight screaming monsters or be warm in our rickety but lovable settlement.
